pick.headline: Former Nigerian minister Umaru Dikko found drugged in a crate at Stansted
pick.fbis: The South Asia Daily Report of July 9, 1984, noted in its Israel roundup that a Foreign Ministry spokesman denied official involvement after two Israelis were arrested in Britain over the attempt to kidnap Umaru Dikko.

evidence.title: FBIS Daily Report: South Asia, Vol. VIII No. 132, 9 July 1984
evidence.snippet: …gotiating through a third party over security arrangements in Lebanon, HA‘ARETZ reported. Regarding the irrest of two Israelis in Britain in connection with the attempt io kidnap former Nigerian Transport Minister Umaru Dikko, an Israeli Foreign Ministry spokesman denied any official Israeli involvement in the affair, DAVAR noted PLO Affairs PLO Executive Committee Chairman Yasir ‘Arafat arrived in Amman on & July and met with Jordan's King…
